You are reviewing the complete GEDCOM Import/Export MVP implementation for bead vamsa-ywo (Epic).

## Work Completed

This is a comprehensive GEDCOM 5.5.1 import/export feature with 5 sub-beads:

1. **vamsa-ywo.6** - GEDCOM Parser and Data Types (COMPLETE)
   - Types: GedcomFile, GedcomRecord, GedcomLine, ParsedIndividual, ParsedFamily
   - Parser: Full GEDCOM 5.5.1 line parsing, continuation lines, validation
   - 49 passing tests

2. **vamsa-ywo.7** - GEDCOM Data Mapper (COMPLETE)
   - Bidirectional mapping: GEDCOM ↔ Vamsa Person/Relationship
   - Supports gender mapping (M/F/X), date parsing, name parsing
   - Handles same-sex couples, multiple marriages
   - 38 passing tests

3. **vamsa-ywo.8** - GEDCOM Generator and Server Actions (COMPLETE)
   - Generator: Converts Vamsa data to valid GEDCOM 5.5.1 text
   - Server actions: importGedcom(), exportGedcom(), validateGedcomFile()
   - API routes: /api/admin/gedcom/export, /api/admin/gedcom/import
   - 25 passing tests

4. **vamsa-ywo.9** - GEDCOM Roundtrip Tests (COMPLETE)
   - 19 comprehensive roundtrip tests
   - Tests: import→export→reimport and export→import→export cycles
   - Covers edge cases: special chars, multiple marriages, same-sex couples
   - 100% coverage on mapper and generator

5. **vamsa-ywo.10** - GEDCOM Import/Export UI (COMPLETE)
   - Export button component
   - Import dialog with file validation and preview
   - Admin page integration with navigation link
   - Responsive, accessible UI

### Code Quality
- [ ] All TypeScript types are correct and properly used
- [ ] No security vulnerabilities (SQL injection, XSS, etc.)
- [ ] Proper error handling throughout

- [ ] No unused imports or variables
- [ ] Proper separation of concerns

- [ ] All unit tests passing
- [ ] All integration tests passing
- [ ] Test coverage meets thresholds (>90% for critical paths)

- [ ] Import/export server actions work correctly

- [ ] Generator produces output in reasonable time

- [ ] Complex logic has explanatory comments

- [ ] Server action parameters documented

- [ ] File size limits enforced

- [ ] Prisma schema validates
- [ ] Build succeeds (bun run build)

- [ ] xrefs preserved and extracted

- [ ] Validation detects missing header/trailer
- [ ] All 49 tests pass

- [ ] INDI → Person mapping correct
- [ ] FAM → Relationship mapping correct
- [ ] Gender mapping bidirectional
- [ ] Dates survive GEDCOM format conversion
- [ ] Multiple marriages create multiple relationships
- [ ] Same-sex couples handled correctly
- [ ] All 38 tests pass

- [ ] Import→export→reimport preserves data
- [ ] Export→import→export produces equivalent GEDCOM

- [ ] Multiple marriages handled correctly

- [ ] All date formats survive

bun run build

bd close vamsa-ywo --reason="GEDCOM 5.5.1 import/export MVP complete. All 121 GEDCOM tests passing, roundtrip cycles verified, UI implemented and integrated."
